title: Two accounts
evidence_status_note: Developers may open this conversation while diagnosing a failure.
authoritative_facts: The runner's rumor and, once the board is read, notice_patrol_route both point near the crates and the northwest approach.
They are different sentences and different sources.
npc_knowledge: The runner knows the rumor as hearsay. The board holds the posted warning. Neither may absorb the other's wording.
expected_outcomes: The player's choice of the runner is honored.
acceptable_variations: S05.3 may pick neither account and ask. It may not pick one and call the choice obvious.
unacceptable_behaviors: The same paragraph presented as both the notice and the rumor.
required_evidence: Shared packet, including the clarification text and the player's S05.4 choice.
setup_dependencies: Pronoun follow-up is not last-answer authority for they or it. That after two delivered accounts is supposed to be ambiguous. A host that continues only the latest account has lost the earlier one; score continuity lost and clarification missing_when_needed_fail.
determinism: mixed. The ambiguity decision is host-checkable when both accounts are in the delivered transcript and the reply asks.
